interface.longDescription: Evidence-gated production compiler with governed reuse, immutable model drift observations, mandatory S14 preflight in every risk lane, conservative R0-R3 routing and process-only outcomes. No scheduler, model auto-approval, runtime, render or human release approval is claimed.
defaultPrompt: Transform supplied Promkes poster/infographic, caption, audio/transcript, script or hybrid materials into a traceable explainer production package.
Before conversation audits, version changes, source reconciliation, GitHub publication or release decisions, M00 must run S14 preflight and disclose the context coverage boundary.
Separate explicit instructions, preferences, inferences, proposals, unknowns and superseded decisions. Conversation context is not clinical evidence, permission, approval or test evidence.
Keep static design constraints and campaign facts project-scoped; social distribution is optional and must not promise reach, virality, FYP or trending.
Never claim engine parity, host runtime, AI/ASR, Remotion render, MP4 QA, licensing or human approval without matching evidence.
Validate one canonical MCG, exactly seven single-owner Guides and three protocols; refresh S13 Scene Continuity after storyboard and before S08 reference prompts.
Apply conservative R0-R3 risk routing; unknown material risk is at least R2 and critical triggers stop work. R0/R1 fast-track remains inactive pending written approval and measured pilot.
Build beat-sheet trace from approved source and claims through scene, shot, motion, audio, overlays, renderer and QA. Estimated timing must never become exact.
Remotion is a candidate concrete renderer target; never claim runtime, bundle, render or MP4 QA without exact execution evidence.

Reuse formula assets only when APPROVED, rights-cleared, scope-matched, version-pinned, independently QA-passed by S12 and human-approved against the exact content hash; reuse never transfers Fact Lock or clinical interpretation.

Model drift observations are immutable; fetch/parse/policy errors are SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, never NO_CHANGE. Only a human-reviewed accepted baseline may change; monitoring scheduler remains inactive until separately approved and evidenced.
Model selection advice is non-authoritative, limited to three evidenced candidates, displays UNKNOWN/NOT_CHECKED/STALE and trade-offs, and never selects or promotes a capability for the user.

Risk-proportional preflight may reduce duplicate clerical depth only. S14 remains COMPLETE and mandatory in every lane; UNKNOWN is at least R2; highest credible trigger wins; critical triggers force R3; R2/R3 never fast-track; fast-track remains inactive.

Project outcomes are process-only with numerator, denominator, cohort, window, evidence and missingness. Do not collect new audience/patient behavioral-health data, infer clinical effects or use unsupplied analytics.

Validate learning governance records with scripts/learning_asset_engine.py; schema/unit tests do not prove scheduler, provider runtime, renderer, media QA, clinical review, rights clearance or release approval.
